sinopsis.es: Ambientada en una aldea remota de Anatolia, Djinn Wedding, de Ferit Karahan, es un imponente drama familiar que va desenredando secretos y conflictos a lo largo de tres épocas.
sinopsis.en: Set in a remote Anatolian village, Ferit Karahan’s Djinn Wedding is an impressive family drama that unravels family secrets and conflicts across three periods of time.
